purpose: Define a consistent, non-misleading presentation of how close an A5 task or daughter module is to independently executable work, while keeping detailed decomposition and WorkDefinition logic protected.
truthRules: REFERENCE_COMPLETE_CANDIDATE does not imply independent runtime proof.
A missing client runtime value is not an Operational Knowledge gap when the required object, applicability, authoritative origin and validation are explicitly defined as bindable.
Executor readiness cannot be PASS while undocumented operational UNKNOWN remains in a required execution path.
Runtime support is not the same as canonical executability; unsupported runtime features remain canonical and are reported as projection gaps.
Public readiness metrics are summaries and must not expose protected branch logic, exact Work Decomposition or full WorkDefinition content.

metrics.label: Further decomposition required
metrics.derivation: Canonical executability assessment only; renderer may not infer.

metrics.label: Executor ready
metrics.hardRule: True only when stop criterion is satisfied and required execution knowledge has no undocumented UNKNOWN.

metrics.label: WorkDefinition
metrics.restriction: Public payload never includes WorkDefinition content.

metrics.label: Required-information coverage
metrics.definition: Required information objects with explicit purpose, required-when, origin class and validation divided by required information objects in assessed scope.

metrics.label: Decision coverage
metrics.definition: Decision gates with explicit required inputs and defined branch handling divided by identified decision gates.

metrics.label: Branch coverage
metrics.definition: Identified pass/fail/hold/retry/escalation/recovery outcomes with defined next state or governed unresolved dependency divided by identified branches.

metrics.label: Evidence coverage
metrics.definition: Completion/control outcomes with explicit evidence requirement divided by outcomes requiring evidence.

metrics.label: Unresolved operational knowledge
metrics.protectedForm: Full gap items, reason, affected branch and source-resolution state.

metrics.label: Client-binding dependency
metrics.clientWorkspaceForm: Full authorized binding requirements and resolution status.

metrics.label: System-action dependency
metrics.protectedForm: Exact system actions and interface dependencies.

metrics.label: Execution profile
metrics.truthRule: Suitability is advisory until Work Decomposition and executor proof; it must not be presented as selected runtime architecture.

compositeCards.rule: Display each metric independently; never collapse to one score that hides a critical zero/unknown.

allow: Work Decomposition/WorkDefinition where explicitly authorized by pilot scope
authorized protected execution detail for the active workspace

deny: owner-only access-policy administration where separately restricted

allow: all fields and governance/access metadata subject to external source-license constraints

p1ExitAssertion: Every readiness field has a truth definition, public form, protected form where applicable, and explicit audience rule.
